readme:
# DistServe 分离队列与双延迟 SLO

## 1. 问题

回放独立prefill/decode服务队列，并按TTFT与TPOT共同约束计算goodput。

一个prefill worker与一个decode worker的FCFS离散事件模型，包含KV传输等待；decode按请求串行，非实际批处理优化器。

原文: [DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving](https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi24/presentation/zhong-yinmin) · Sections 2 and 3: TTFT/TPOT, disaggregated prefill and decoding, goodput.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
F_i=\max(A_i,F_{i-1})+P_i,\quad E_i=\max(F_i+K_i,E_{i-1})+(n_i-1)D_i,\quad TTFT_i=F_i-A_i,\quad TPOT_i=\frac{E_i-F_i}{n_i-1}.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `disaggregated_trace(arrivals: list[float], prefill: list[float], decode: list[float], transfer: list[float], tokens: list[int]) -> tuple[list[float], list[float]]` — First- and last-token times under independent FCFS workers.
- `slo_goodput(arrivals: list[float], first: list[float], last: list[float], tokens: list[int], ttft_limit: float, tpot_limit: float) -> float` — Joint TTFT/TPOT-compliant request rate over the observation horizon.

分别维护prefill结束和decode结束时钟；decode只依赖自己的worker、当前请求的prefill完成和传输完成。用首末token之间的全部等待计算平均TPOT，不能只取裸decode服务时间。

## 4. 本题约定

输入为等长Python数值列表，arrivals非负且非递减；prefill/decode时间>0，transfer>=0，tokens为>=2整数。第一个token在prefill结束F产生，KV传输仅影响后续decode。两个worker分别保持FCFS输入顺序；传输可重叠。返回(first,last)；goodput=同时达标请求数/(max(last)-min(arrivals))，阈值含等号。

## 5. 交互图

三个同时到达的请求在prefill耗时4、decode耗时1、每请求3token下回放，扫描KV传输时间；比较双SLO达标goodput并记录first/last时刻。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

en.readme:
# DistServe Disaggregated Queues and Dual Latency SLOs

## 1. Problem

Replay separate prefill/decode queues and compute goodput subject to both TTFT and TPOT.

An FCFS discrete-event model with one prefill worker and one decode worker, including KV-transfer waits; request-serial decoding is a teaching simplification.

Source: [DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving](https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi24/presentation/zhong-yinmin) · Sections 2 and 3: TTFT/TPOT, disaggregated prefill and decoding, goodput.

## 2. Core equations

$$
F_i=\max(A_i,F_{i-1})+P_i,\quad E_i=\max(F_i+K_i,E_{i-1})+(n_i-1)D_i,\quad TTFT_i=F_i-A_i,\quad TPOT_i=\frac{E_i-F_i}{n_i-1}.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `disaggregated_trace(arrivals: list[float], prefill: list[float], decode: list[float], transfer: list[float], tokens: list[int]) -> tuple[list[float], list[float]]` — First- and last-token times under independent FCFS workers.
- `slo_goodput(arrivals: list[float], first: list[float], last: list[float], tokens: list[int], ttft_limit: float, tpot_limit: float) -> float` — Joint TTFT/TPOT-compliant request rate over the observation horizon.

Maintain separate worker clocks. Decode waits for its own worker and the current request’s prefill plus transfer. Average TPOT includes all waiting between first and last tokens, not only raw decode service cost.

## 4. Conventions

Equal-length numeric lists: nonnegative sorted arrivals, positive prefill/decode costs, nonnegative transfer costs, integer tokens>=2. Prefill completion F produces the first token; KV transfer affects later decoding. Each worker follows input FCFS order and transfer may overlap. Return (first,last). Goodput is jointly compliant requests divided by max(last)-min(arrivals), with inclusive thresholds.

## 5. Experiment view

Replay three simultaneous requests with prefill cost four, decode cost one and three output tokens, sweeping KV-transfer time. Report first/last-token times and jointly compliant goodput.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.
